from pathlib import Path
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
mods=['app','realtime-client','privileged-helper','audio-bridge']
total=0
for m in mods:
    t=f=e=s=0
    for p in Path(m).glob('build/test-results/testDebugUnitTest/TEST-*.xml'):
        r=ET.parse(p).getroot(); t+=int(r.attrib.get('tests','0')); f+=int(r.attrib.get('failures','0')); e+=int(r.attrib.get('errors','0')); s+=int(r.attrib.get('skipped','0'))
    print(f'{m}_jvm_tests={t} failures={f} errors={e} skipped={s}')
    total+=t
print(f'jvm_tests_total={total}')
roots=[Path('app/src/main'),Path('realtime-client/src/main'),Path('privileged-helper/src/main'),Path('audio-bridge/src/main')]
rows=[]
for root in roots:
    for p in root.rglob('*'):
        if p.suffix in {'.kt','.java'}:
            n=p.read_text(errors='replace').count('\n')+1; rows.append((n,str(p)))
print(f'production_source_files={len(rows)}')
print(f'production_source_lines={sum(n for n,_ in rows)}')
for n,p in sorted(rows,reverse=True)[:8]: print(f'largest_source={n}:{p}')
PY
